Splendid! This part covered the foundations of R including [operators](/foundations/operatos), [variables](/foundations/variables), and [functions](/foundations/functions).

Attempt the below MCQs by choosing the correct option in the below sentences to recap what you have learnt.

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c( "Annotations", "Variables", answer = "Operators")
```
1. <u>_________</u> are symbols that allow you to carry out common R tasks such as addition and multiplication. `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c(answer = "Annotations", "Objects", "Operators")
```
2. Hash tags (`#`) can be used to create human readable <u>________</u> `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c("Annotations", answer="Objects", "Operators")
```
3. <u>________</u> can be assigned as R Variables `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c(
   answer = "`<-`", "`==`", "`>=`"
)
```
4. The assignment operator is: <u>________</u> `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c("Console", answer = "Function","Objects")
```
5. `sqrt` is a R <u>________</u> `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval=TRUE}
opts_p <- c(answer="Console", "Function","Object")
```
6. You can run commands in the <u>________</u> `r longmcq(opts_p)`

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Tippy tooltips
tippy::tippy_this(elementId = "operator_tooltip", 
                  tooltip = "+, -, /, *, etc.",
                  arrow = TRUE, placement = "bottom")
tippy::tippy_this(elementId = "variable_tooltip", 
                  tooltip = "Container of an R object with a name",
                  arrow = TRUE, placement = "bottom")
tippy::tippy_this(elementId = "function_tooltip", 
                  tooltip = "Named block of code that performs a specific task",
                  arrow = TRUE, placement = "bottom")
```
